title: Mac OS & Windows System Install
description:
SSD Upgrade with OS Reinstallation & Data Migration

At E-Tech, we offer SSD replacement and upgrade services with optional operating system reinstallation and data migration, carried out using structured procedures to ensure data integrity and system stability.

Before installation, our technicians evaluate system compatibility and storage configuration. Data is transferred using verified cloning or manual migration methods, depending on drive condition and system requirements.


Service Options

• Fresh operating system installation (Windows / macOS)

• Full system cloning from old drive to SSD

• Selective data migration (documents, photos, user files)

• Boot configuration and system optimisation after installation


Data Handling & Safety

• Pre-upgrade storage health assessment

• Secure data transfer procedures

• Verification of data integrity after migration

• Original drive retained until confirmation is completed


Technical Notes

• OS reinstall and data migration are optional services

• Service time may vary depending on data size and drive condition

• Severely damaged drives may limit data recovery or cloning


Professional SSD Upgrade You Can Rely On

Bring your laptop or desktop computer to E-Tech for a complete SSD upgrade solution — including system installation and secure data migration — for faster, more reliable performance.
